rule.name: WallClockBoundInTest
rule.message: This test fails when the machine is slow: it puts a limit of under one second on measured wall-clock time, and a busy CI runner, a garbage collection pause or a cold cache can take longer than that. Assert the behaviour instead (the calls made, a counter of the work done) and keep speed checks in a benchmark. A limit of a second or more that only guards against a hang is allowed.
